metadata.description: Baseball, football and basketball plugins whose numbers are computed by tested scripts and checked against published sources.

plugins.name: baseball
plugins.description: Rules, scoring and sabermetrics for MLB and college baseball. A tested script computes wOBA, wRC+ and FIP with FanGraphs' constants and builds league constants for college; guides cover reliability, context and free data sources.

plugins.name: football
plugins.description: Rules, EPA, success rate and quarterback evaluation for the NFL and college. A tested script computes team and player efficiency from nflverse play-by-play and passer ratings; guides cover filters, context and free data sources.

plugins.name: basketball
plugins.description: Rules, possessions, ratings and the Four Factors for the NBA and college. A tested script builds team ratings from real box scores and computes true shooting and usage; guides cover context and free data sources.

plugins.name: cbb-sabermetrics
plugins.description: Live college baseball sabermetrics for 330 NCAA DI programs — wOBA, wRC+, FIP, BABIP, ISO, conference power index, SOS-adjusted rankings. Wraps the Blaze Sports Intel MCP at blazesportsintel.com/mcp. Free tier, 30 requests/min, no API key.

plugins.name: texas-longhorns-intel
plugins.description: Texas Longhorns baseball intelligence — scouting reports, SEC matchup previews, roster evaluation, NIL efficiency analysis, program history. Depends on cbb-sabermetrics.
